key_insight: SymPlex discovers analytical symbolic solutions to PDEs without ground-truth by framing expression generation as tree-structured decision-making and optimizing candidate formulas directly against the PDE and boundary conditions using a structure-aware Transformer (SymFormer).
problem_solved: Automates discovery of closed-form symbolic PDE solutions when no labeled expressions exist, navigating the vast, syntax-constrained search space of mathematical expressions while satisfying PDE residuals and boundary conditions.
method: Formulate symbolic PDE solving as a reinforcement learning problem over expression trees, using PDE residuals and boundary-condition satisfaction as the reward signal.
Introduce SymFormer, a structure-aware Transformer employing tree-relative self-attention to model hierarchical symbolic dependencies and enforce syntactic constraints during generation.
Iteratively generate, evaluate, and optimize candidate symbolic expressions (no ground-truth supervision) to produce analytical solutions that minimize PDE residuals.
impact: Enables automated discovery of interpretable, closed-form PDE solutions directly from governing equations, benefiting scientific ML, model interpretability, and domains where analytic expressions are preferred over black-box numeric solvers.
visual_elements: Diagram of tree-structured symbolic expression generation (nodes = operators/operands) with arrows showing sequential decisions
Architecture schematic of SymFormer highlighting tree-relative self-attention and how hierarchical dependencies are encoded
RL optimization loop: generate expression → evaluate PDE residual & boundary conditions → reward → update policy
Before/after comparison: numeric solution heatmap vs discovered symbolic solution + residual error plot
paper_title: SymPlex: A Structure-Aware Transformer for Symbolic PDE Solving
paper_authors: Yesom Park, Annie C. Lu, Shao-Ching Huang, Qiyang Hu, Y. Sungtaek Ju
